title: Load shared map graphics on demand
changes: Move graphics and palettes shared by three focused map pages to one content-addressed local asset loaded only on request; keep map cells immediately available and preserve single-page behavior.
Allow retry after missing or invalid assets while preserving the selected map and update the affected section timestamps.
validation: Synthetic viewer-lazy-maps-synthetic-budbp5gi passed 29 source, browser and regression tests including missing-file retry and manual pixels.

Protected viewer-lazy-maps-real-okbh5lh6 checked all three offline pages with 117 graphics and 184 palette choices, preserved 32 scoped payloads and 180 resource pages, and matched 1076 Python/Docker files.
Each focused page fell from about 4.2 MB to about 0.95 MB before the optional 2.96 MB shared asset loads. Published 35 private files with verified preimages out/ffta-lazy-maps-before-xfub0ev3.
limitations: Graphics and palette combinations remain manual; their original scene pairings are not established. Native Windows remains deferred.
